where: The Hollowing's acolytes and Vigilants (incl. the summit guard), and the far-valley Lampwardens of the North and West (Mira Vael, Ysolde Frost, Lucan Pyre, Nessa Cole)
mood: The fight in the deepening dark — cold, uneasy and solemn: an enemy who believes in the gentle night, sorrow under the steel.
core_styles: cold minor-key sawtooth lead melody with tritone leaps
tight sampled drums with tom-heavy fills
uneasy dark battle theme, solemn and sorrowful rather than evil

sections.name: Shadow Falls
sections.text: {the lanterns gutter: a low organ chord hit, a fast descending chromatic run in the bass and lead together, a tom roll that drops into the driving battle theme}

sections.name: Nightfall Theme
sections.text: {the main theme: a cold, sorrowful minor-key hook on the sawtooth lead over a creeping chromatic bass ostinato and solemn organ chords, driving and tense}

sections.name: Nightfall Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the hook again with icy bell accents doubling the lead an octave up, low brass swells underneath, the drums tighter and more insistent}

sections.name: Vigil Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: the drums thin to a steady tom pulse, a slow mournful melody over a borrowed major chord — the enemy's sorrow and conviction, almost beautiful — then a rising chromatic climb back into the fight}

sections.name: Nightfall Theme Return
sections.text: {the cold minor hook returns at full intensity; the last bar is a tom fill on the dominant leading straight back into the theme, no ending}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
